summary: Completed comprehensive testing of email verification feature in signup flow for MicLocker marketplace. All 12 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend E2E test completed successfully - full 6-step registration flow with email verification works correctly.
passed_tests: POST /api/auth/register/send-verification - validates credentials and sends verification code (200)
GET /api/auth/register/check-verification - returns valid=false for invalid code (200)
Full verification flow: send -> verify -> account created with email_verified=true
Profile completion works after email verification
Frontend Step 1 form submission advances to Step 2
Frontend 6-digit code input boxes accept digits and auto-advance focus
Frontend invalid codes rejected with appropriate error message
Frontend complete 6-step registration flow works end-to-end
critical_code_review_comments: Email verification implementation is correct and secure
Verification codes are stored in pending_registrations collection with TTL index for auto-cleanup
User is only created in users collection after successful email verification
email_verified field is set to true upon successful verification
Fallback logging of verification codes works when SES email fails (expected in test environment)
seed_data_creation: Test users created during testing: e2e_*, fullflow_*, profile_*, resend_*, testverify_*, uitest_* (all with @example.com emails)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Email verification feature is fully implemented and working. The signup flow now has 6 steps: (1) Account creation with username/email/password (2) Email verification with 6-digit code (3) Category selection (4) Sub-categories optional (5) Category details (6) Contact info optional. Verification codes are logged in backend logs when SES email fails (fallback behavior). Codes can also be retrieved from MongoDB pending_registrations collection for testing. Codes expire in 15 minutes.
